Package com.mimecast.robin.scanners

Class AuthenticationHeaders

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.scanners.AuthenticationHeaders
public final class AuthenticationHeaders extends Object
Builds the trace headers Robin adds to inbound messages: an RFC 8601 Authentication-Results header and SpamAssassin-style X-Spam-* headers.

SPF, DKIM, DMARC and ARC verdicts come from the Rspamd scan result; a check Rspamd did not report is left out. Robin adds auth for authenticated sessions and iprev for clients with a public address, so the header is present even when Rspamd is disabled.

    • authenticationResults

      public static String authenticationResults(String authservId, Session session, MessageEnvelope envelope, Map<String,Object> rspamd, AuthenticationHeaders.Resolver resolver)
      Builds the Authentication-Results value.
      Parameters:
      authservId - Robin's authentication service identifier, normally its hostname.
      session - Session the message arrived on.
      envelope - Envelope of the message.
      rspamd - Rspamd scan result, or null when the message was not scanned.
      resolver - Forward resolver for the iprev check.
      Returns:
      Header value, without the field name.

    • spamHeaders

      public static List<String[]> spamHeaders(Map<String,Object> rspamd)
      Builds the X-Spam-* headers from an Rspamd scan result.

      A message is spam when Rspamd asked for it to be marked (add header or rewrite subject) or its score reached the add header threshold. Rejected messages never get this far.

      Parameters:
      rspamd - Rspamd scan result, or null when the message was not scanned.
      Returns:
      Name and value pairs, in order; empty when there is no usable score.

    • claims
